answer.answer: The Scheme for Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance Abuse is a program that supports activities of non-governmental organisations working in prevention of addiction and rehabilitation of drug users [E01]. Its aims and objectives include: creating awareness about the ill-effects of substance abuse to individuals, families, workplaces and society [E01]; alleviating consequences of drug and alcohol dependence [E01]; evolving community-based services for identification, motivation, detoxification, counselling, aftercare and rehabilitation of drug users [E01]; and facilitating research, training, documentation and collection of relevant information [E01]. The scheme employs strategies such as developing culture-specific prevention and treatment models, promoting collective initiatives and self-help efforts, promoting community participation, creating trained human resource personnel, facilitating networking among stakeholders, and promoting continuous monitoring and evaluation [E01].
